title: Brand-campaign sentiment & emotion
note: Counts are over the news/press items that had sentiment+emotion computed, from the real Campaign_analysis outputs.
takeaway: BMW's incremental logo change stayed ~neutral (minimal backlash). Jaguar's rebrand and Coca-Cola's AI ad drew heavy anger (Jaguar anger ≈ neutral), i.e. backlash scales with distance from brand heritage and perceived cost-cutting.
